summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the closure of its wholly owned U.S. subsidiary, Genenta Science, Inc., following a strategic review. The closure is expected by July 31, 2026, with minimal one-time charges. Concurrently, CFO Richard B. Slansky transitions to a 12-month consulting role effective June 1, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or deal advisors are disclosed. The board opted to streamline operations and focus on an Italian/European aggregator strategy. This is a minor corporate streamlining, not a transformative restructuring; risk-arb angle is negligible.
